prompts:
Use case: identity-preserve. Edit target reference is character 8.png. Create a production cutout component atlas for THIS SAME young male anime character, preserving tousled dark brown hair, blue-gray eyes, navy blue short open jacket with pale beige trim, rolled white cuffs, white open collared shirt over black undershirt, brown diagonal leather strap, double waist belt, brown pouches and thigh straps, dark brown trousers, tall brown lace-up boots with folded tops, black fingerless gloves. Simplify tiny stitching only. No redesign, no cape, no new profession insignia. All anatomy viewed facing RIGHT in natural near-side three-quarter side view (nose points right, one dominant eye), not front view. Need detachable complete pieces with rounded hidden joint overlap, no cut-off edges or shadows. True transparent background. Draw exactly 20 isolated components on a regular 5 column by 4 row grid, row-major, each centered within its own cell with generous empty gap, no text, no grid lines, no assembled figure:
row 1: 1 head and face with ears and neck but no hair, 2 back brown hair mass, 3 front tousled brown bangs, 4 jacket/shirt chest with diagonal strap and collar, 5 pelvis with double belt and pouches and short trouser crotch.
row 2: 6 far LEFT upper arm with navy sleeve, 7 far LEFT forearm with white rolled cuff and exposed skin, 8 far LEFT relaxed gloved hand, 9 near RIGHT upper arm with navy sleeve, 10 near RIGHT forearm white cuff exposed skin with leather wrist cuff.
row 3: 11 near RIGHT gloved fist with clear hole to hold sword, 12 far LEFT dark trouser thigh, 13 far LEFT boot shin with folded top, 14 far LEFT boot foot pointing right, 15 near RIGHT dark trouser thigh with leather thigh pouch and straps.
row 4: 16 near RIGHT boot shin with folded top, 17 near RIGHT boot foot pointing right, 18 simple straight steel sword with brown leather handle and restrained brass crossguard, blade points up-right, 19 rear navy jacket tail with beige edge, 20 front white shirt tail with narrow navy jacket edge.
Upper arms and forearms point down, thighs shins vertical, feet right, head right. Every piece individually fully rendered with hidden joint ends filled and seamless matching colors. Sword grip clearly separate. Flat consistent game sprite illustration, confident outlines, clean shading. Entire atlas high resolution square 2048 preferred. IMPORTANT layout exactly 5x4, 20 pieces, nothing else.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this exact 5-column 4-row transparent component atlas. Keep EVERY component in same cell, same scale, same bounding position, same character identity, colors, details, rightward facing, and 20 component order. Correct rigging errors only: REMOVE all artificial skin-colored cylindrical pegs and circle holes on clothing, pelvis, thigh, shin, and tails. Replace those joints with smooth rounded matching FABRIC or LEATHER continuation filled behind joint, not skin. The bare face neck and exposed forearms remain skin. Upper sleeves (row2 col1 and col4) should be short upper-arm-only navy sleeves ending in rounded navy fabric, REMOVE duplicate rolled white cuffs on those two pieces; the white cuffs belong to separate forearms. Head must retain face and neck, do not add hair there. Row1 col2 hair should have only brown hair with no skin neck peg. Row1 col3 front hair slightly shorter, allow eye visibility. Row3 col1 fist retains grip hole and fingers. Sword retains handle. Row1 col5 pelvis retain belts brown pouches and trousers but no skin pegs. Row4 col4/5 tails no skin pegs. All detached pieces keep enough rounded overlap to hide seams during rotation. No text, no labels, no grid, no shadows, genuine transparent background. Do not redraw as an assembled character. Preserve exact atlas layout and reference character.
